```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ordinal)
library(broom)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv('data/processed/q1/q1-analysis.csv') %>% as_tibble()
```

```{r}
head(data)
```

```{r}
model_data <- data %>%
  select(n_ud_pstat, stat_comfort) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    # Treat comfort as an ordered categorical outcome
    stat_comfort = ordered(
      stat_comfort,
      levels = 1:5
    )
  )
glimpse(model_data)

```

```{r}
table(model_data$stat_comfort)

```

```{r}
table(model_data$n_ud_pstat)
```

```{r}
ordinal_fit <- clm(
  stat_comfort ~ n_ud_pstat,
  data = model_data,
  link = "logit"
)
```

```{r}
summary(ordinal_fit)

```
